name: WEAI 19th International Conference (Seoul 2027)
organizer: Western Economic Association International (WEAI), in partnership with Sogang University
deadline_note: Individual (volunteer) paper abstracts: page states 'October 15' without a year (the 2026 date for this April 2027 meeting). Organized sessions and discussant/chair volunteers: December 1.
submission_requirements: Abstract of 350 words or less via the WEAI online abstract form; complete papers requested by April 1 for circulation to session participants; presenters must register
submission_fee: $50 members / $100 non-members (added to registration); waived for papers in organized sessions
registration_fee: Professionals: $290 members / $360 non-members early (through Feb 15), $340 / $410 after; students/postdocs: $135 members / $170 non-members early, $160 / $195 after
keynotes: Chang Yong Rhee (former Governor, Bank of Korea); Soohyung Lee (Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Board / Seoul National University); Caroline Hoxby (Stanford University)
